theme_central: "The Inevitable Reality": five past destructions as small-scale proof, before the cosmic scene of the Judgment where everyone receives their record in the right hand or the left.
sources_note: Ring structure precisely sourced (ayahguide.com, Reflection & Tadabbur): 1-3, 4-12, 13-18, 18-37, 38-52.

branches.title: The Inevitable Reality announced
branches.resume: Threefold emphatic affirmation of the certainty of al-Haqqah.

children.t: Threefold affirmation of the certainty of al-Haqqah, the Inevitable Reality

branches.title: Destruction of the ancient peoples
branches.resume: Five nations destroyed in rapid succession: Thamud, 'Ad, Pharaoh, Nuh — each a miniature proof of al-Haqqah.

children.t: Thamud destroyed by the Cry, 'Ad by a howling wind for seven nights and eight days
Pharaoh and the peoples before him, Nuh saved by the ark

branches.title: Cosmic dissolution
branches.resume: The Trumpet, the earth crushed to dust, the sky torn apart, eight angels bearing the Throne.

children.t: The Trumpet, earth crushed to dust, sky torn apart, eight angels bearing the Throne

branches.title: Individual judgment
branches.resume: Shift from the cosmic to the personal: record received in the right hand or the left.

children.t: Record received in the right hand, radiant joy in Paradise
Record received in the left hand, bitter regret, torment in Hell

branches.title: Prophetic defense
branches.resume: The Qur'an defended: the word of a noble messenger, neither poet nor soothsayer; truth from the Lord of the worlds.

children.t: Defense of the Qur'an: neither poetry nor divination, truth from the Lord of the worlds
